description: A PHP class 'OA_Admin_Option' for managing display and configuration of settings and preferences in the Revive Adserver project, including UI rendering, permission checks, and configuration handling.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Option
classes.description: Class for managing display options, settings, and preferences in the admin interface of Revive Adserver.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, loads language files, and sets up the template.

methods.name: _writeJavascriptFunctions
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript functions for UI interactions.

methods.name: getSettingsPreferences
methods.description: Returns sections of settings or preferences based on the option type.

methods.name: selection
methods.description: Builds a menu for selecting settings or preferences sections.

methods.name: _mergePluginOptions
methods.description: Merges plugin-specific options into sections.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Builds and displays the user interface for settings or preferences.

methods.name: _hideOrDisablePreference
methods.description: Determines if a preference should be hidden or disabled based on account type.

methods.name: _showCheckDependancies
methods.description: Generates JavaScript for dependent form elements.

methods.name: _showGetType
methods.description: Returns the type of a form element based on its name.

methods.name: _showStartSection
methods.description: Begins a section in the UI display.

methods.name: _showEndSection
methods.description: Ends a section in the UI display.

methods.name: _showPlainText
methods.description: Displays plain text in the UI.

methods.name: _showBreak
methods.description: Displays a break or separator in the UI.

methods.name: _showCheckbox
methods.description: Displays a checkbox input.

methods.name: _showHiddenCheckbox
methods.description: Displays a hidden checkbox input.

methods.name: _showHiddenField
methods.description: Displays a hidden input field.

methods.name: _showText
methods.description: Displays a text input.

methods.name: _showUrl
methods.description: Displays a URL input.

methods.name: _showTextarea
methods.description: Displays a textarea input.

methods.name: _showPassword
methods.description: Displays a password input, with optional hiding if config is not writable.

methods.name: _showSelect
methods.description: Displays a select dropdown.

methods.name: _showStatsColumns
methods.description: Displays columns for statistics preferences, with access control.

methods.name: _assignAccountsIds
methods.description: Assigns account IDs to the template.

methods.name: _showPadLock
methods.description: Returns HTML for padlock icon based on disabled state.

methods.name: _disabledValue
methods.description: Determines if a setting should be disabled based on config writability.

methods.name: _display_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts size strings to bytes.

methods.name: _bytes_to_display
methods.description: Converts bytes to human-readable size string.

methods.name: pearLogPriorityToConstrantName
methods.description: Converts PEAR_LOG_* level to string name.
